quantity.name: original length
quantity.definition: ALL/PLL: midheight of inferior to midheight of superior vertebral body; LF/ISL: superior to inferior attachment; SSL: midheight posterior spinous processes; JC: tip of inferior facet to tip of superior facet

source.authors: Pintar FA, Yoganandan N, Myers T, Elhagediab A, Sances A Jr
source.sample: 132 ligament samples from 38 fresh cadavers (mechanics, data of Myklebust et al. 1988); geometry from 8 additional cadavers; human cadaveric lumbar ligaments T12-S1 (ALL, PLL, JC, LF, ISL, SSL), in situ isolation tests to failure
source.age: geometry cadavers 31-80 y (mean 63); mechanics cadavers not reported here

protocol.summary: Cryomicrotomy of 8 frozen intact cadavers (31-80 y, mean 63); values pooled T12-S1 by ligament type
how_to_simulate: Compare model ligament geometry (CSA or reference length) per ligament type with the T12-S1 pooled mean and range

extraction.check_notes: Table 1 read from page render (OCR garbled JC/LF n): n = 25, 21, 24, 22, 18, 22.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
